text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, come on, please!
I'm begging you here!! Please!?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Persistent bastard. Like I give a damn.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Listen to this,
I have to take a makeup test for math~!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If you don't pass, it'll mess with your training, right?
That's why you're clinging to the rescue boat!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Like I said, that's got nothin' to do with me.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Ugh, can't you help me out here somehow—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! That out-of-print CD you wanted to hearâ
my mom actually has a copy.
How about trading for that!?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...
Tch, fine. No choice, then.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! You've got quite an eye for treasure yourself!
I'm counting on you, Teach!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Let's start with something simple.
Solve this.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Seriously?
What part of this is supposed to be easy?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
......*sigh*
First, substitute 3 for x――

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—And finally, reduce the fraction. That's it.
Once you know the method, it's a simple problem.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I see... So that's how it is...
Okay, let's give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
First, we substitute for x, right...?
So the next step is surely—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, finished.
Is this right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Well, that checks out.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: I did it!!

Tap Dance City may have scored low enough to need a make-up exam,
but she seems naturally sharp.
choice_data_list: Let's keep this up and solve a bunch more!
Let's take on a tough problem and test your skills!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
I'm gonna get the hang of it completely!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Plus, Professor Shakur's
a great teacher!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm just relaying the logic as it is.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You think so?
I think you'd make a great teacher!
(Thump!)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Shut up and solve them. All of them.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hah!
Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Finally finished...
I thought I was gonna drown in a sea of numbers...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Not bad.
You should be able to pass a makeup exam at this rate.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Really!? Thanks, Shakur!
I'll contact Mom about the CD right away!!"
Later on, Tap Dance City patiently worked through her makeup exam and passed.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come on! Keep the Spartan discipline
strictly to our training!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I just whipped these up.
If you can solve them, the makeup exam will be a breeze.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: W-What the heck...? My head's startin' to spin...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: “Still, it's for my training... A wave this size is nothing, I'll ride it out with ease!!”

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOAH!!
I solved it, Shakur!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hmph.
Correct.
choice_data_list: With this, you're sure to ace the makeup exam!
With this, you're sure to ace the makeup exam!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you saved my skin!
I was busy hanging out with my friends and hadn't studied at all!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*
Do that sort of thing on a regular basis.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm never gonna let anyone
come crying to me like that again.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If that happens, I'll offer up another treasure!
That's fine, right?
Later on, Tap Dance City faced her makeup exam head-on and passed.
